messages:
incident-bot: P1 Alert: serve-runtime pods in eu-central-1 experiencing crash-looping after eviction. Symptom set: ephemeral-storage eviction events, large journal files, repeated CUDA init failures on restart -> customer-facing 5xx spike. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/9981 :rotating_light:

sam (oncall): ack. Pulling logs. Any running deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy `serve-runtime:v2.15.0` started canary to eu-central-1 (1/4) 30s ago.

sam (oncall): hold that canary. leo - can you confirm cluster capacity?

leo (platform): checking node pressure. Initial `kubectl get nodes` shows node ip-10-1-122 at 98% ephemeral-storage. `journalctl --disk-usage` shows journald using 55GB on that host. Looks like `runtime-debug` logger didn't rotate.

raj (eng-infra): `kubectl describe pod serve-runtime-6b7f2` event excerpt:
```
Warning  Evicted  18s  kubelet  The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage
```

mina (eng-runtime): pod logs show big tracebacks and repeated debug dumps:
```
E modelcache: shard download failed: write /var/lib/modelcache/shard-abc: no space left on device
E serve: crashloop: attempting restart
E cuda: driver init failed: CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN (after allocation retry)
```

mina (eng-runtime): unlike previous incidents this host kept huge journal logs from debug-level exceptions. Also found leftover snapshotter temp dirs from an older containerd GC run.

tess (sre): customer impact: 7 customers inside eu-central-1 seeing ~20% error rate on generation endpoints since 09:42 UTC. Escalating.

sam (oncall): mitigation plan step 0: pause canary. step 1: cordon affected nodes and drain safely. step 2: free disk on node to allow kubelet stable state. step 3: temporary traffic steering: increase weight to other AZs. step 4: reduce logging and disable prefetch on runtime. step 5: fallback to smaller FP16 quantized model for a fraction of traffic.

leo (platform): pausing canary: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/serve-runtime` — done.

raj (eng-infra): draining node but keeping critical pods: `kubectl drain ip-10-1-122 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data=false --pod-selector='app!=audit'` — careful not to force-delete PV-backed apps.

sam (oncall): raj, can you ssh and run a targeted cleanup rather than nuking `/var/log`? we want minimal disruption.

raj (eng-infra): on host:
```
sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=1G
sudo rm -f /var/log/serve-runtime-debug-*.log
sudo find /var/lib/containerd -type f -name '*.tmp' -delete
```
Freed ~48GB. Journal reduced to 1.2GB.

mina (eng-runtime): pushing hotfix env: `kubectl set env deploy/serve-runtime LOG_LEVEL=info PREFETCH_ENABLED=false` — reduces debug noise and prefetch.

deploy-bot: env patch applied; rollout started and paused for manual verify.

sam (oncall): after cleanup, restarted one replica on clean node. Watch for `cuInit` errors.

mina (eng-runtime): new pod started cleanly but we saw one `cuInit()` warning then recovered. Added exponential backoff on model shard load to avoid immediate re-tries that blow VRAM. Will push a fix to gate shard downloads when disk/memory signals low.

tess (sre): metrics: 5xx dropped from 20% -> 4% in 6m after cleanup + routing. Latency near baseline for most traffic.

maria (support): customers D/E/F reported errors earlier; I sent interim message: "We experienced degraded responses due to node storage pressure in eu-central-1 which caused pod restarts. We've freed disk space, reduced logging, and rerouted traffic. Engineers are monitoring and preparing an RCA."

sam (oncall): follow-up checklist we need captured: 
- ensure runtime logs rotate correctly (add logrotate or stdout only)
- change runtime image to compress debug dumps or limit size
- move model shards off ephemeral into PV or shared cache 
- add kubelet eviction soft threshold alerts and node disk exporter alert at 80%
- modify containerd GC schedule to run more frequently on model-serving nodes

mina (eng-runtime): opened PR #5123: add `max-shard-load-retries`, prefetch toggle, and healthcheck backoff.

raj (eng-infra): created infra ticket INF-20260315-09 to increase node allocatable ephemeral-storage and add node-level disk alerts.

sam (oncall): creating incident record INC-20260315-089 with timeline and customer impact. Assigning postmortem to mina/raj/tess. Handoff to tess in 20m.

tess (sre): ack. I'll start the postmortem doc and include the commands that freed space. Also recommend adding a CI test to simulate large journal growth on a node.

leo (platform): long-term: option to mount a medium=Memory emptyDir for transient debug files and use hostPath/PV for shard storage. Also propose a pre-deploy healthcheck that fails canary if node disk usage > 70%.

maria (support): sending follow-up to impacted customers with ETA for RCA.

incident-bot: Severity changed: P1 -> mitigation. Incident state: in_progress -> mitigated (monitoring).

sam (oncall): leaving notes in the incident doc. Handoff to @tess. If we see any new CUDA OOMs paste full log lines here so we can correlate.

tess (sre): ack, monitoring now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
